nurse.text: Hiya! Welcome to St Andrews Sanctuary. Your team looks like it's been round the Old Course in a gale. Pop them on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: There's a pot of tea on, and a tin of shortbread that the students haven't found. Yet.
All better. Off you go, and don't step on the PH in the cobbles. Everybody says it's just a superstition. Everybody walks round it.
The Ark's in the corner. It's older than the university, nearly. Have a click.

else.text: No bother. Enjoy the town, and mind the golf balls.
